arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ لِإيلٰفِ قُرَيشٍ

translation: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer
So let them worship the Lord of this House

arabic: الَّذى أَطعَمَهُم مِن جوعٍ وَءامَنَهُم مِن خَوفٍ
transliteration: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin
translation: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear
